title: cistanthe maritima

It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities that may help to soothe skin irritations, reduce pain, and boost the immune system. Further research is needed to fully understand the potential health benefits and mechanisms of action of this plant.
